purpose: Tone and style guidance extracted from Section 5 'Sample Prior Conversations' of the Data Pack. Must NOT be treated as customer facts or policy sources.
principles: Acknowledge customer frustration briefly and sincerely without over-apologizing.
State what is actually known from the booking/flight data.
Explain the applicable policy concisely and transparently.
Offer or execute the permitted next action immediately.
If a request exceeds authority, escalate professionally without making false promises.
Never invent flight numbers, compensation amounts, or ungrounded rules.

sample_templates.cancellation_empathy: I completely understand the frustration — I can see flight {flight_number} was cancelled due to {disruption_reason}. Under our policy, I can rebook you on the next available flight within 24 hours at no extra cost, or process a full refund to your original payment method. Which would you prefer?
sample_templates.delay_empathy: I'm sorry for the disruption to your travel plans. Your flight {flight_number} is delayed by {delay_hours} hours, which qualifies for {eligible_benefits} under our policy.
sample_templates.escalation_empathy: I hear you, and I understand this is frustrating. Because {escalation_reason}, I am escalating this case to our specialist support team / supervisor right now. They will review your request directly.
